reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "The unused flag `sidecar-istio-proxy-image` has been removed", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: setting-ignored

consequence.statement: The flag --sidecar-istio-proxy-image is no longer honoured and will be ignored by Cilium 1.16.0.

proposed.statement: The unused CLI flag --sidecar-istio-proxy-image has been removed in Cilium 1.16.0.
